projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
New analytics dashboard delivering three core capabilities: (1) ingestion and processing of customer CSV files into a queryable analytics store, (2) analysis of application log data for operational and usage insight, and (3) visualization components and dashboard UI that surface both data sources to end users. Scope covers data modeling, ingestion pipelines, log parsing/aggregation, API/query layer, frontend charts and filters, testing, and deployment readiness.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, csv, logs, visualization

tasks.name: M1 · Discovery, data contracts & architecture
tasks.details: Milestone container. Establish stakeholder questions/KPIs, inventory and profile the customer CSV and application log sources, define data contracts and the target warehouse schema, and lock the architecture (batch cadence, storage, query/API layer, frontend stack). Exit criteria: signed-off source inventory, schema/contract docs, and an architecture decision record.

tasks.name: M2 · Customer CSV ingestion & processing pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone container. Build the end-to-end path from raw customer CSV drop to validated, deduplicated, conformed records in the analytics store: file landing/intake, parsing, schema validation, cleaning/normalization, identity resolution, incremental loads, and pipeline observability.

tasks.name: M3 · Application log analysis pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone container. Build log ingestion and analysis: collection/transport from app servers and services, parsing of structured and semi-structured log lines, event normalization, enrichment, aggregation into usage/error/latency metrics, retention tiering, and pipeline monitoring.

tasks.name: M4 · Analytics data model & query API
tasks.details: Milestone container. Model the curated analytics layer (facts/dimensions/marts) shared by CSV and log data, and expose it through a query API: metric definitions, aggregation tables, filtering/date-range endpoints, caching, pagination, and access control.

tasks.name: M5 · Visualization components & dashboard UI
tasks.details: Milestone container. Deliver the user-facing dashboard: component library and chart primitives, CSV-derived revenue/customer views, log-derived operational health views, global filters/date picker, dashboard shell and navigation, and empty/loading/error states with accessibility.

tasks.name: M6 · Integration, testing & performance hardening
tasks.details: Milestone container. End-to-end verification of the delivered system: automated checks across the CSV and log paths, reconciliation of metric totals against source, API contract validation, browser coverage of core journeys, load runs at realistic volume, and an access-control review. Exit criterion: all suites green plus stakeholder UAT sign-off.

tasks.name: M7 · Deployment & launch readiness
tasks.details: Milestone container. Ship it safely: CI/CD for pipelines and frontend, infrastructure as code, scheduled orchestration and alerting, runbooks/on-call docs, staged rollout, and post-launch KPI validation with stakeholders.

tasks.name: Interview stakeholders and define KPI catalogue
tasks.details: Run 3-4 structured interviews with sales, support and engineering stakeholders. Capture the decisions each dashboard view must support, then write a KPI catalogue: metric name, definition, formula, source system, grain, and target refresh cadence. Deliverable: KPI catalogue doc with agreed top 10 metrics.

tasks.name: Inventory and profile customer CSV sources
tasks.details: For each customer CSV feed, document: owner, delivery mechanism (SFTP/email/bucket), file naming convention, encoding, delimiter, header variation, row volume, update frequency, and known quality issues. Sample 3 files per feed and record null rates, duplicate keys, and date formats. Deliverable: source inventory spreadsheet plus 5 sample fixtures checked into the repo.

tasks.name: Profile application log sources and formats
tasks.details: Catalogue every service that emits logs: log format (JSON/plaintext), timestamp format and timezone, severity vocabulary, request/correlation ID presence, daily volume, retention currently in place, and transport available (stdout, file, syslog, agent). Sample lines from each service into fixtures. Deliverable: log source matrix and documented volume estimate for capacity planning.

tasks.name: Define data contracts and field-level schemas
tasks.details: Write versioned data contracts for the customer CSV entities and the normalized log event schema. For each field specify type, nullability, allowed values, PII classification, and owner. Define the contract-change process (versioning, deprecation window, notification). Deliverable: contracts/ directory with schema files and a one-page governance note.

tasks.name: Write architecture decision record and batch cadence plan
tasks.details: Decide and document: warehouse/storage engine, batch vs micro-batch cadence for CSV (daily expected) and logs (15-min expected), orchestration tool, query API stack, frontend framework and chart library, secrets management, and environments (dev/staging/prod). Include cost estimate and rejected alternatives. Deliverable: ADR-001 approved by tech lead.

tasks.name: Build CSV file landing and intake watcher
tasks.details: Implement the intake job that watches the configured bucket/SFTP drop, moves new files to a raw/ landing prefix partitioned by source and ingestion date, computes a checksum, and records metadata (source, filename, size, arrival time, checksum) in an ingestion ledger. Must be idempotent: re-seeing the same checksum skips reprocessing. Cover with unit tests for new/duplicate/malformed filename cases.

tasks.name: Implement CSV parser with encoding and delimiter handling
tasks.details: Build the parsing module: detect/configure encoding (UTF-8 with BOM, Latin-1 fallback), delimiter and quote character, handle embedded newlines in quoted fields, ragged rows, and header aliasing per source. Emit parsed rows to a staging table with source_file_id and line_number for traceability. Unit-test against the fixtures captured in discovery.

tasks.name: Add schema validation with quarantine handling
tasks.details: Enforce the M1 data contracts on parsed rows: required fields, types, allowed enum values, and date/number formats. Valid rows proceed; invalid rows go to a quarantine table with the failing rule and original payload, never silently dropped. Publish counts of valid/rejected per file to the ingestion ledger. Include unit tests for each violation type.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning and normalization rules
tasks.details: Apply per-field transformations: trim whitespace, canonicalize case for country codes and currencies, parse multiple incoming date formats to UTC, normalize phone/email formats, map legacy status values to the agreed vocabulary, and coerce currency minor units. Keep a rules file so transformations are data-driven and reviewable. Unit tests per rule plus a fixture round-trip test.

tasks.name: Implement customer identity resolution and dedupe
tasks.details: Define the match key hierarchy (customer_id, then normalized email, then name+postcode fallback) and implement survivorship rules for conflicting attributes (most recent file wins, non-null beats null). Produce a golden customer record plus a link table mapping source rows to it. Report match rates and ambiguous matches for review. Unit tests with synthetic duplicate clusters.

tasks.name: Build incremental upsert load into analytics store
tasks.details: Implement the merge/upsert of conformed customer records into the curated table using a business key and effective-dated history where attributes change. Must be transactionally safe and re-runnable for the same batch without duplicating rows. Include a row-count reconciliation step against staging and unit tests for insert, update, no-op and replay scenarios.

tasks.name: Add CSV pipeline observability and backfill utility
tasks.details: Emit per-run metrics (files seen, rows parsed, rows rejected, duration, last successful watermark) and wire alert thresholds for failed runs, zero-row files, and rejection spikes above 5%. Then add a CLI/utility to reprocess a date range or a specific file from raw landing into curated tables for recovery and schema-evolution backfills.

tasks.name: Set up log collection and shipping
tasks.details: Configure the log agent/forwarder for each service identified in discovery: tail files or capture stdout, attach service/environment/host metadata, buffer locally during outages, and ship to the raw log store partitioned by date and service. Verify delivery with a canary service that emits a known heartbeat line every minute.

tasks.name: Implement log parser for structured and plaintext formats
tasks.details: Build per-format parsers: pass-through for JSON logs, and a regex/grok pattern set for plaintext services (timestamp, level, logger, message, stack trace). Handle multi-line stack traces by continuation matching so one exception stays one event. Route unparseable lines to a dead-letter table with the raw text. Unit tests per service format plus a fuzz test for truncated lines.

tasks.name: Normalize log events to the common event schema
tasks.details: Map every parsed log line into the shared event schema from the M1 contract: event_time (UTC), service, environment, severity normalized to DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR/FATAL, message, error_code, latency_ms, request_id, user_id and trace_id when present. Validate against the contract and drop to dead-letter on failure. Unit tests covering each source's normalization mapping.

tasks.name: Add log enrichment: service catalog and user mapping
tasks.details: Join normalized events against reference data: a service catalog (team, tier, on-call owner) and a pseudonymized user mapping so usage metrics can be attributed without exposing raw identifiers. Add geo/region derivation from host metadata. Document PII handling and hashing rules. Unit tests for missing reference keys falling back gracefully rather than dropping events.

tasks.name: Build error and latency aggregation jobs
tasks.details: Create scheduled aggregations at 1-minute and 1-hour grains: error counts by service and error_code, error rate as errors/requests, p50/p95/p99 latency, and slowest endpoints. Define how missing minutes are treated (gap vs zero) and store results in the metrics table keyed by service/metric/grain/bucket. Unit tests with synthetic event sets verifying each aggregate.

tasks.name: Build usage and activity aggregation jobs
tasks.details: Derive product usage metrics from normalized events: daily/weekly active users, sessions per user, feature/endpoint hit counts, and top actions. Define sessionization rules (30-minute inactivity window) and deduplicate retried requests via request_id. Store as daily grain metrics per user segment and feature. Unit tests for session boundary and dedupe cases.

tasks.name: Configure log retention tiers and pipeline monitoring
tasks.details: Implement retention: raw events kept 30 days, hour aggregates 13 months, day aggregates 3 years, with the archival/downsampling job that enforces it. Then add pipeline health monitoring: ingestion lag vs event_time, dead-letter rate, parse failure rate, and alert routing when lag exceeds 15 minutes or parse failures exceed 1%.

tasks.name: Design dimensional model for facts and dimensions
tasks.details: Produce the physical model for the curated layer: dim_customer (SCD2), dim_service, dim_date, fct_customer_metrics, fct_service_health and fct_usage_daily. Specify keys, grain, partition columns, clustering, and nullability. Write DDL and a schema diagram. Review against the KPI catalogue to confirm every metric is computable from the model.

tasks.name: Write metric definitions and semantic layer spec
tasks.details: Translate the KPI catalogue into executable metric definitions: source table, aggregation, filters, default time grain, unit, and rounding. Include denominator rules for rates and an explicit list of metrics that must never be summed across periods. Deliverable: metrics.yml consumed by the API layer, reviewed by a stakeholder for each domain.

tasks.name: Build aggregation and mart tables
tasks.details: Implement the scheduled jobs that materialize the marts: customer revenue/count rollups by day and segment, and service health rollups by hour and day. Each job is incremental on the watermark, re-runnable for a date window, and records row counts. Include a freshness column used later by the API. Unit tests comparing mart output to direct-from-source queries on a small fixture set.

tasks.name: Implement metric and time-series API endpoints
tasks.details: Build read endpoints: GET /metrics (catalogue), GET /metrics/{id}/series with from/to/grain params, and GET /metrics/{id}/summary for single-value KPI cards. Enforce a maximum range per grain, validate parameters with clear 400 errors, and return the data-freshness timestamp on every response. Integration tests per endpoint using a seeded test database.

tasks.name: Add filtering, sorting and pagination to API
tasks.details: Add query parameters for dimension filters (segment, country, service, environment, severity), multi-value selection, sort field/direction, and cursor-based pagination for table endpoints. Whitelist filterable fields against the semantic layer to prevent arbitrary column access. Include a max page size and tests for invalid filter names, empty results and cursor stability.

tasks.name: Add caching layer for dashboard queries
tasks.details: Introduce a cache keyed by metric + filters + grain + period, with a TTL aligned to pipeline cadence (5 minutes for log metrics, 1 hour for daily CSV metrics). Implement invalidate-on-refresh hooks from the pipeline jobs and an X-Cache header for debugging. Measure hit rate and confirm no stale-data regressions with a test that advances the clock.

tasks.name: Implement API auth, access rules and OpenAPI docs
tasks.details: Add authentication for dashboard clients, role-based access (viewer vs admin), and row-level scoping so users only see permitted customer segments. Publish an OpenAPI 3 spec with examples for every endpoint and wire it to a docs page. Include tests for 401/403 paths and a short security note describing token lifetime and secret storage.

tasks.name: Set up frontend app shell, routing and API client
tasks.details: Scaffold the dashboard app with routing for the Customer, Revenue, Service Health and Usage views, a shared layout with header/sidebar, environment config, and a typed API client generated from the OpenAPI spec. Add an error boundary and request retry with backoff. Confirm the shell renders and routes in dev and CI.

tasks.name: Build chart primitives: KPI card, line, bar and table
tasks.details: Create a small reusable chart layer wrapping the chosen chart library: KpiCard (value, delta, sparkline), TimeSeriesLine (multi-series, tooltip, legend), BarChart (categorical/stacked) and DataTable (sortable, paginated). Each takes typed props and handles its own tooltip/legend formatting and number/date formatting. Include Storybook-style examples and snapshot tests for each primitive.

tasks.name: Build global filter bar and date range picker
tasks.details: Implement the shared filter state (URL-synced so views are linkable): date range with presets (7d/30d/90d/custom), segment, country, service and environment multi-selects. Filters must propagate to every view and reset to documented defaults. Include a summary of active filters as removable chips and tests for URL round-trip and default state.

tasks.name: Build customer and revenue views from CSV data
tasks.details: Compose the CSV-driven views: customer count and new-customer trend, revenue over time, revenue by segment/country, and a searchable customer table with drill-down to a single customer's detail panel. Wire to the M4 metric endpoints and include a CSV export of the visible table. Component tests with mocked API responses covering populated and empty datasets.

tasks.name: Build service health and usage views from log data
tasks.details: Compose the log-driven views: error-rate and request-volume time series per service, p95 latency trend, top error codes table, and a DAU/feature-usage panel. Include a service selector and a severity breakdown chart. Wire to the log metrics endpoints with auto-refresh every 5 minutes (paused when the tab is hidden). Companion tests with mocked responses.

tasks.name: Add loading, empty and error states plus data-freshness indicator
tasks.details: Implement skeletons for each view while data loads, friendly empty states when filters return no rows, and inline error cards with a retry action when the API fails. Add a global data-freshness badge showing the last successful pipeline refresh and a stale-data warning past threshold. Verify each state with tests that force loading/empty/error responses.

tasks.name: Run accessibility and responsive layout pass
tasks.details: Audit the dashboard for WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard navigation through filters and tables, visible focus states, colour contrast on charts and status colours, alt text/aria labels on visualizations, and a data-table fallback for each chart. Then verify layouts at 1280px, 1024px and 768px widths, fixing overflow and chart legibility. Deliverable: audit checklist with resolved findings.

tasks.name: Write end-to-end tests for the CSV path
tasks.details: Build an automated E2E suite that drops fixture CSV files into the landing zone and asserts the resulting curated rows: happy path, duplicate file replay, malformed row quarantine, new customer insert, and changed attribute producing a new SCD2 version. Run against an ephemeral test warehouse in CI. Include a data-volume smoke test at 100k rows.

tasks.name: Write end-to-end tests for the log path
tasks.details: Ship synthetic log lines for every supported format through the collection endpoint and assert the normalized events, aggregates and API output. Cover multi-line exceptions, unparseable lines landing in dead-letter, late-arriving events, and the canary heartbeat. Run in CI against the ephemeral stack with a fixed clock.

tasks.name: Implement data quality and reconciliation checks
tasks.details: Add scheduled assertions: row counts staging vs curated, no duplicate business keys in current records, no future-dated events, required-field null rate under threshold, and metric totals reconciling to source within 0.5%. Failures write to a quality results table and raise alerts. Backfill 30 days and record the baseline pass rate before launch.

tasks.name: Add API contract tests
tasks.details: Add tests that validate every API response against the OpenAPI schema, including error envelopes, and fail CI when the spec and implementation drift. Cover the metric catalogue, series, summary, filter and pagination endpoints plus auth 401/403 cases. Include one negative test per validation rule.

tasks.name: Add frontend end-to-end and visual regression tests
tasks.details: Write browser E2E tests for the core journeys: load dashboard, change date range, filter by segment, open a customer detail, open service health and switch service. Mock the API for determinism and run against staging once per deploy. Capture screenshots of each view at 1280px and diff against baselines to catch unintended visual changes.

tasks.name: Run load and performance testing at realistic volume
tasks.details: Define targets (dashboard view p95 under 2s, API metric query p95 under 500ms at 50 concurrent users) and test with production-like volumes: 5M log events/day and a 1M-row customer table. Measure pipeline runtime, API latency/cache hit rate, and frontend render time. Tune indexes/partitions where targets are missed and record results in a performance report.

tasks.name: Complete security review and UAT sign-off
tasks.details: Review PII handling end to end (hashed user IDs, no raw identifiers in API responses), confirm secrets are not in code or logs, verify row-level access rules with a test per role, and check dependency vulnerabilities. Then run a 60-minute UAT session with stakeholders walking the KPI list, logging gaps as tickets, and capture written sign-off or a documented exception list.

tasks.name: Build CI/CD for data pipeline jobs
tasks.details: Add pipeline CI: lint, unit tests, contract validation, and a build artifact on every PR; on merge to main, deploy jobs to staging and promote to production behind manual approval. Include schema-migration steps that run before job deployment and automatic rollback on failed smoke tests. Verify with a full dry-run deploy.

tasks.name: Build CI/CD for API and frontend deploys
tasks.details: Set up API and frontend pipelines: type-check/lint, unit and contract tests, bundle build, container image publish with a pinned tag, and staged deploy (staging then production). Add preview environments per PR for UI review, and post-deploy health checks that fail the release if the API or app does not respond healthy.

tasks.name: Define infrastructure as code and secrets management
tasks.details: Codify the storage buckets, warehouse/dataset, compute for jobs, API hosting and frontend hosting in IaC with separate dev/staging/prod stacks. Store all credentials in the secrets manager and reference them at runtime, never in code. Include a plan output review step and a documented disaster-recovery note (backup cadence, restore test date).

tasks.name: Configure orchestration schedules, retries and alerting
tasks.details: Register the production schedules (CSV daily at 02:00 source-local, log aggregation every 15 minutes, marts after each source run), with dependency ordering, retry policy (3 attempts, exponential backoff), SLA timeouts and failure notifications to the on-call channel. Add a scheduled freshness check that alerts if any mart is more than 2x its cadence stale.

tasks.name: Build operational dashboards and runbooks
tasks.details: Create an internal ops dashboard for pipeline health (run status, rows processed, rejection rate, lag, API error rate and latency) and write runbooks covering: rerun a failed CSV batch, replay a log window, recover from a bad schema deploy, rotate a secret, and roll back a release. Include escalation contacts and expected recovery times.

tasks.name: Execute staged rollout and rollback rehearsal
tasks.details: Roll out to an internal pilot group first (flag-gated), verify pipeline freshness and dashboard accuracy for 3 business days, then expand to all users. Before expansion, rehearse rollback: revert the release, confirm the previous version serves traffic, and confirm data migrations are backward compatible. Record go/no-go decision and timings.

tasks.name: Run post-launch KPI validation and close-out
tasks.details: Two weeks after launch, compare dashboard values against source-of-truth spot checks for each of the top 10 KPIs, review usage telemetry to confirm which views are actually used, and collect stakeholder feedback. Produce a close-out report: KPI accuracy results, adoption numbers, open defects, and a prioritized backlog for phase 2.
